results.name: AArete Names Healthcare Leader Pam Shipley as CEO - AArete
results.content:
# AArete Names Healthcare Executive Pam Shipley as Chief Executive Officer  
*Global consulting firm’s founder Loren Trimble to step down after 18 years of growth and recognized excellence*  
**CHICAGO**–([BUSINESS WIRE](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260810294659/en/AArete-Names-Healthcare-Executive-Pam-Shipley-as-Chief-Executive-Officer))–[AArete](https://www.aarete.com/), a leading global management and technology consulting firm, announced today the appointment of Pam Shipley as chief executive officer. A Fortune 25 healthcare executive with more than 30 years of experience, Shipley succeeds AArete Founder Loren Trimble, who will transition from his role as CEO to board member.  
Shipley joins AArete from Centene Corporation, a leading managed care organization, in which she most recently served as chief strategy officer. She spent nearly 14 years at Centene over two tenures where she held multiple CEO roles in Georgia, Missouri and Mississippi and led digital transformation and market expansion across more than 15 markets.
AArete drives profitability improvement, digital transformation and AI solutions for clients across a range of industries, including the healthcare payer segment, which has become the firm’s signature strength. The firm advises on U.S. health plans of every type, including Medicaid, Medicare, ACA Marketplace and commercial, helping clients manage the total cost of care and expand affordability without sacrificing quality or the member experience. In 2025, AArete secured a strategic investment from Parthenon Capital, a growth-oriented private equity firm with deep experience backing healthcare solutions and technology companies, further strengthening the firm’s continued growth.  
“What we’ve built at AArete would not be possible without a culture built on integrity, excellence and care for the people we serve, and I’m proud that Pam will continue that legacy,” Trimble said. “She’s a purpose-driven leader whose passion for people and delivering results for clients reflects the values of the firm. I am confident she will lead AArete into its next chapter and build on its success.”
Trimble established AArete in 2008 with the goal of building a consulting firm that nurtures long-term client partnerships. Under his leadership, AArete grew into a global firm with more than 500 team members, earning recognition as a [Forbes World’s Best Management Consulting Firm](https://www.forbes.com/lists/worlds-best-management-consulting-firms/) for four consecutive years and a [USA Today Top Workplaces Award](https://topworkplaces.com/company/aarete/), underscoring the firm’s strong culture and people-first approach.  
“AArete has become an essential partner to many of the nation’s leading health plans, and Pam is exactly the right leader to build on the firm’s momentum going forward,” said Dan Killeen, partner at Parthenon Capital. “Her payer expertise and track record of driving growth and performance make her uniquely suited to lead AArete into the future. We are grateful to Loren for his visionary leadership and look forward to his continued engagement as a member of the board.”

results.name: AArete Appoints Pam Price & Gina Hedstrom MDs - AArete
results.content:
# AArete Expands Healthcare Consulting Practice with 2 Managing Directors  
*Strategic leadership hires reinforce AArete’s commitment to healthcare innovation*  
CHICAGO–([BUSINESS WIRE](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20250930838855/en/AArete-Expands-Healthcare-Consulting-Practice-with-2-Managing-Directors))–[AArete](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.aarete.com%2F&esheet=54330096&newsitemid=20250930838855&lan=en-US&anchor=AArete&index=1&md5=dcf26f2a53d7e54eab04feb63ae8beeb), a leading global management and technology consulting firm, announced today the addition of two managing directors, Pam Price and Gina Hedstrom. Price’s and Hedstrom’s appointments further position the firm’s healthcare consulting practice for continued growth and excellence.  
“With decades of healthcare experience, Pam and Gina bring invaluable perspective to AArete clients,” said AArete CEO[Loren Trimble](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.aarete.com%2Fabout-us%2Fleadership%2Floren-trimble%2F&esheet=54330096&newsitemid=20250930838855&lan=en-US&anchor=Loren%20Trimble&index=2&md5=2ca620779b3f03595dc09f865f8e386b). “Their expertise enhances our ability to deliver data-driven, AI-powered solutions that address the most complex challenges facing healthcare organizations today.”  
*AArete has hired two new managing directors, Pam Price (left) and Gina Hedstrom*
**Gina Hedstrom, RN, managing director:**Hedstrom is a seasoned healthcare consultant with over two decades of experience transforming payer and provider operations across the U.S. Throughout her career, she has served as trusted advisor to many U.S. health payers, driving improvements in policy optimization, claims adjudication, utilization management, credentialing and medical record audits. As a registered nurse, she integrates clinical, technical and executive expertise to serve clients. Hedstrom will serve as managing director in[AArete’s Payment Intelligence®](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fpayment-intelligence.aarete.com%2F&esheet=54330096&newsitemid=20250930838855&lan=en-US&anchor=AArete%26%238217%3Bs%20Payment%20Intelligence%26%23174%3B&index=5&md5=8f5562edd43cdcabca35387feb64d0ca)practice, leading strategic initiatives in payment accuracy, automation, operational strategy and healthcare data innovation.  
AArete’s commitment to excellence is demonstrated by industry honors, including being globally recognized for four consecutive years as a**Forbes World’s Best Management Consulting Firm**, and being named one of**Forbes’ America’s Best Management Consulting Firms 2025**in the category of Healthcare & Life Sciences. In addition, Modern Healthcare recognized the firm as one of the**Largest Healthcare Management Consulting Firms in 2025**.
### **About AArete**  
AArete is a global management and technology consulting firm specializing in driving profitability improvement, digital transformation, and strategy & change for clients. AArete’s solutions are powered by a digital-first mindset, market intelligence and data-driven approach to deliver purposeful change, actionable insights and guaranteed results. AArete humanizes data by translating numbers into actionable insights, helping clients make better decisions and standing by their side to foster change with confidence, empathy and purpose.
